payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Comparing source and edited images, is there clear visible progress toward placing the source paper into the source cup, short of the paper being fully stuffed inside?
node.criteria: Pass only if the source paper and source cup can be reliably matched to visible edited objects and their edited relation clearly shows an intermediate placement toward putting the paper into that cup, but not completed stuffing. Fail only if the relevant objects and their relation are reliably identifiable and clearly show no progress toward that placement. Unknown if object correspondence, visibility, or the relation is too ambiguous to determine progress. Mere proximity, holding, or rim contact alone is not progress.
node.binding: Compare source and edited images for the requested paper-into-cup change. Use visible evidence to establish object correspondence and placement; do not infer identity from color alone or count unrelated edits. If the source objects cannot be reliably located in the edit, return unknown rather than treating their apparent absence as no progress.
